name: sd-phone
description: A open-source phone project for FiveM.

paragraphs: The phone and tablet UIs run here with sample data. Unlock the phone, move apps around, install apps, open the police terminal or use fullscreen. Nothing to install.

sd-phone is a FiveM phone for QBOX, QBCORE, ESX, oxcore and ND. It includes calls, messages, mail, maps, banking, photos, social apps and games. Apps use server data and their own accounts where needed. The camera shows the game world. Phone props come in eight colours and match the on-screen frame. Unique phones and SIM cards are optional; each phone item can keep its own number and data.

Scripts and custom apps written for lb-phone, qs-smartphone, gksphone, roadphone or YSeries can keep using their old exports and events. For lb-phone and YSeries, the import can bring over numbers, chats, photos, wallet history, social logins and more.
features: Real accounts. Social apps have registration, sign-in and password resets delivered by in-game mail or SMS, and accounts work across characters.
A live camera. The Camera shows the game world in real time, clips record your microphone and nearby voices, and Photogram Live streams real video to other phones.
Plugged into your server. Garages and Homes work with 14 garage and 12 housing systems, Wallet reads your framework's bank, and Services turns jobs into companies players can call and message.
Custom apps. One export turns any web page into an installable app, and apps built for lb-phone run unmodified. Start from the app templates and the custom app guide.
Drop-in compatible. Scripts written for lb-phone, qs-smartphone, gksphone, roadphone or YSeries keep working: their exports are answered and their events mirrored. Details
